name: Known pc-Minimal Obstructions to Dismantlable Ampleness
statement: Every $Q_n^{--}$ for $n\geq3$ and Hall's class $C_H$ is pc-minimal outside the dismantlable ample class. Moreover, the $Q_n^{--}$ are exactly all nonample members of the complete excluded basis. The remaining ample pc-minimal obstructions are not classified.
proof: Each $Q_n^{--}$ is nonample, while every elementary restriction is $Q_{n-1}^-$ and every elementary contraction is $Q_{n-1}$, both dismantlable ample. Any nonample pc-minimal failure contains some $Q_n^{--}$ by the ample-class obstruction theorem and therefore equals it. Hall's class has no corner, while the exact verifier supplies corner peelings for every elementary restriction and contraction; pc-minor closure then handles all proper minors.
comments: The complete ample obstruction family is open. The current exact size bound excludes additional ample failures on at most fourteen vertices.
